title: Monochrome Watercolor Travel Poster
summary: Create a 4:5 city poster with fine ink architecture, soft monochrome watercolor, white space, and a small serif city title. Use the source fields or choose a prepared blue scene for Tokyo, Seoul, Singapore, or Istanbul.
seoDescription: Create a 4:5 watercolor city poster with fine ink linework and a serif title. Choose Tokyo, Seoul, Singapore, Istanbul, or fill the original city fields.
inputRequirement: No reference image is required. Choose a prepared city scene, or use Custom city and fill every bracketed field after copying.
howToUse: Choose a blue city scene, or keep Custom city to use the original fields. The prepared scenes change the city, country, landmarks, street lamp, vehicle, and title together.
For Custom city, replace every bracketed field after copying. Use the same city and country in the opening and title, and choose one watercolor color.
Copy the complete prompt into your image generator. The source recommends GPT Image 2 on ChatGPT; this project has not tested that model.
Keep the 4:5 frame, fine ink linework, white space, quiet morning light, and small serif title. To try another color, edit the color phrase after copying.
exampleNotice: Four complete city posters from the source post are shown. They were re-encoded as JPEGs at their original 1122 × 1402 size without cropping. The author's exact field values were not supplied.
verificationNotice: The source names GPT Image 2 on ChatGPT. These are source-reported examples; Image Prompt Book has not independently generated them or verified the model.
adaptationNotice: The English original is preserved verbatim, and Custom city reproduces it in full. Chinese is a complete translation. The four blue city presets fill the source fields using the cities and street details in the examples; they are project adaptations, not the author's recorded generation settings.
